data.goal: BOD-225: Record the producing Verdict version and git SHA in run receipts. build_run_receipt adds optional producer {verdict_version, git_sha, dirty} (backward compatible; null values explicit, never guessed). Record it once at run_started so resume keeps the original producer. certify_release.py step_rehearsals reports each rehearsal producer SHA and marks INCOMPLETE when it differs from the certified SHA AND verdict/ changed between them. Tests through the real receipt builder and the real step_rehearsals.

acceptance: A newly started real orchestration run records a producer object containing exactly verdict_version, git_sha, and dirty.
Producer values come from authoritative package metadata and git commands; failed or unavailable lookups produce explicit null values and are never guessed.
Producer provenance is captured once for a durable run, and resuming after package, commit, or dirty-state changes preserves the original producer snapshot.
build_run_receipt copies the producer from the first run_started event and never recomputes provenance while building a receipt.
When producer is present, all three producer keys are emitted, including explicit null values.
Legacy event logs without producer remain buildable and omit the optional producer field for backward compatibility.
Tests exercise the real run path and the real build_run_receipt function, including resume and legacy behavior.
nodes.objective: Capture Verdict package and repository provenance once when an orchestration run starts, then project that original snapshot into run receipts without inferring missing values.
nodes.story: Add the optional producer receipt contract and preserve the first run's provenance across resume. Keep legacy event logs and receipts valid.

acceptance: step_rehearsals reports every rehearsal name and its producer git_sha, using an explicit unknown or null representation rather than inventing a SHA.
run_certification supplies the manifest's certified git SHA to rehearsal verification while existing three-argument step_rehearsals callers remain supported.
A rehearsal remains PASS when its producer SHA equals the certified SHA.
A rehearsal from a different SHA remains PASS when git confirms there were no changes under verdict/ between the producer and certified revisions.
A rehearsal is INCOMPLETE when its producer SHA differs from the certified SHA and git confirms that verdict/ changed between those revisions.
Existing missing-file and events-digest failures remain FAIL and take precedence over provenance freshness.

Tests create receipts with the real build_run_receipt function and pass them through the real step_rehearsals function, covering equal SHA, differing SHA without verdict/ changes, and differing SHA with verdict/ changes.
nodes.objective: Extend release rehearsal verification to report each receipt's producer SHA and detect stale rehearsals whose differing producer SHA spans changes under verdict/.
nodes.story: Bind rehearsal evidence to the certified source while allowing rehearsals from another SHA when no Verdict package code changed between the two revisions.

acceptance: The producer object has one consistent shape across run_started events, generated receipts, and certification checks.
Resume tests prove that certification sees the original run producer rather than current repository state.
Legacy receipts remain accepted and no test relies on hand-built producer receipt dictionaries where the real builder can be used.
All focused receipt, resume, and release certification tests pass together.
nodes.objective: Integrate the producer receipt and release rehearsal changes and validate their combined behavior.
nodes.story: Resolve any contract mismatch between orchestration provenance capture, receipt projection, and certification freshness checks, then run the focused combined suite.

rationale: decision=WORKER_CRITIC: 3 nodes but no layer width>=2 (implement_nodes=2, widest_layer=1) -> sequential worker+critic
